description: Default ldap_server_port=389 selects cleartext LDAP; bind credentials transit unencrypted unless admin switches to LDAPS:636 + use_tls.
LDAP bind password stored as plaintext fields.Char in res.company.ldap; any DB read (backup, replica) exposes credentials in cleartext.
IoT Box hostapd config exposes SSID 'IoTBox' with no wpa_passphrase / wpa key_mgmt; provisioning traffic flows over open Wi-Fi.
subprocess.run with shell=True executes f-string-built sudo chroot bash -c; any contamination of 'commands' yields root command injection.
fetchmail.server.password is plain fields.Char; IMAP/POP3 mailbox passwords sit unencrypted in fetchmail_server and any DB dump.
Webhook signature uses hashlib.md5(raw_body + notification_key); MD5 is collision-broken and SHOULD be replaced with HMAC-SHA-256.
/web/database/create auth=none silently resets master password to attacker-supplied master_pwd when admin_passwd is still default 'admin'.
/web/database/duplicate auth=none silently resets master password to attacker-supplied master_pwd when admin_passwd is still default 'admin'.
/web/database/drop auth=none silently resets master password to attacker-supplied master_pwd when admin_passwd is still default 'admin'.
/web/database/backup auth=none silently resets master password to attacker-supplied master_pwd when admin_passwd is still default 'admin'.
/web/database/restore auth=none silently resets master password to attacker-supplied master_pwd when admin_passwd is still default 'admin'.
printWindow.document.write interpolates this.state.file.defaultSource (incl. YouTube token derived from url) into raw HTML enabling DOM XSS.
Bundled debian/odoo.conf ships ';admin_passwd = admin' as commented default; deployments that uncomment without editing inherit hard-coded credential.
ir.mail_server.smtp_pass is a plaintext fields.Char; outbound SMTP credentials persist unencrypted in DB even though groups='base.group_system'.
session_id cookie set with httponly=True but no secure=True flag; over plain HTTP the session token leaks to any network observer (MITM).
session_id cookie set without SameSite attribute; browsers default Lax, but absent explicit Strict/Lax weakens defense vs cross-site requests.
subprocess.call('net stop {0} && net start {0}'.format(nt_service_name), shell=True); nt_service_name is internal but pattern violates safe shell usage.
admin_passwd option declared with my_default='admin'; absent explicit override the master DB-manager password is the hard-coded literal 'admin'.
cryptography==3.4.8 (py<3.12) is from 2021; affected by CVE-2023-0286 (X.400 type confusion) and CVE-2023-23931 (Cipher.update_into memory corruption).
docutils==0.17 (py<3.11) is from 2021 and unmaintained on this pin; RST rendering paths fed user content may inherit known issues.
gevent==21.8.0 (py==3.10) is multiple major versions behind upstream; no targeted high-impact CVE but unmaintained on this pin.
greenlet==1.1.2 (py==3.10) is from 2021 and trails upstream by years; runtime stack-switching primitive unmaintained on this pin.
Jinja2==3.0.3 (py<=3.10) is from 2021; affected by CVE-2024-22195 and CVE-2024-34064 (xmlattr filter HTML attribute injection / XSS).
lxml==4.8.0 (py<=3.10) is from 2022; affected by CVE-2022-2309 (NULL pointer deref) and trails the 4.9.x security branch.
MarkupSafe==2.0.1 (py<=3.10) is from 2021 and unmaintained on this pin; sits below Jinja2/Werkzeug rendering stack.
Pillow==9.0.1 (py<=3.10) is from 2022; affected by image-parser CVE-2022-22815/22816/22817, CVE-2022-30595, CVE-2023-44271 among others.
psycopg2==2.9.2 (py==3.10) is from 2021; no major published security CVEs but unmaintained on this pin relative to current 2.9.x security fixes.
pyopenssl==21.0.0 (py<3.12) is from 2021; trails major TLS-related fixes shipped in 22.x / 23.x and pinned to legacy cryptography 3.4.8.
PyPDF2==1.26.0 (py<=3.10) is from 2016 and EOL upstream; affected by CVE-2022-24859 / CVE-2023-36464 and predates the modern pypdf rewrite.
reportlab==3.6.8 (py<=3.10) is from 2022; affected by CVE-2023-33733 (paraparser code execution via crafted RML/SVG color expression).
requests==2.25.1 (py<3.11) is from 2020; affected by CVE-2023-32681 (proxy-Authorization leak via cross-origin redirect).
urllib3==1.26.5 (py<3.12) is from 2021; affected by CVE-2023-43804/45803 (Cookie/auth header leak on redirect) and CVE-2024-37891 (proxy header leak).
Werkzeug==2.0.2 (py<=3.10) is from 2021; affected by CVE-2023-25577 (DoS multipart), CVE-2023-46136 (DoS multipart cookies), CVE-2024-34069 (debugger PIN).
ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2 enables deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 in the bundled Nginx reference config; RFC 8996 formally deprecates both.
